statement: Operators can start, continue, and land a Quest through three safe façade commands backed by stable structured action codes and exact verifier receipts, while component commands remain available for diagnostics and no façade command executes rendered command strings or pushes.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
The continue façade dispatches only stable action codes with validated payloads; it never parses or executes the human-rendered action value.
Committing through continue requires an explicit changeRef or explicit --auto-diff plus summary; there is no implicit working-tree capture.
Land validates verifier identity, verdict, and fingerprint against current candidate bytes before recording a receipt; rejection never commits and approval commits scope-safely without pushing.
